question: Find the name and date of events with expenses for pizza that were more than fifty dollars but less than a hundred dollars.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "event_expenses_integrated" AS WITH budgets_clean AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    (budget_id_prefix || budget_id_suffix) AS budget_id,
    link_to_event
  FROM table_2
),
events_pivot AS (
  SELECT
    rid AS event_id,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN sjid IN ('name','event_name','event title','title') THEN value END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(sjid) LIKE '%name%' THEN value END)
    ) AS event_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN sjid = 'event_date' THEN value END) AS event_date
  FROM table_1
  GROUP BY rid
)
SELECT
  e.event_id,
  e.event_name,
  e.event_date,
  x.expense_id,
  x.cost AS expense_cost,
  x.items AS expense_items
FROM table_3 AS x
JOIN budgets_clean AS b
  ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN events_pivot AS e
  ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  event_name,
  DATE(CAST(event_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS event_date
FROM event_expenses_integrated
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(expense_items, '')) LIKE '%pizza%'
  AND expense_cost > 50
  AND expense_cost < 100
ORDER BY event_date, event_name;
